events.title: Iran War Escalation
events.summary: The Iran war shows military strength of the US, but also its waning geopolitical power. The conflict has become a war of military, economy, and geopolitics. The US is expected to leave interest rates unchanged next month after soft inflation data.
events.reasoning: The Iran war escalation is expected to increase demand for defense stocks, while oil services stocks may decline due to reduced oil production. The US interest rates remaining unchanged will also impact the market.

timeFrame.note: Watch for a ceasefire or a significant escalation

events.exitStrategy: Exit when a ceasefire is announced or when the conflict escalates further
